title.zh: 将奎松省与卢塞纳市的区域审判法院分庭由十三（13）个增至十四（14）个，新设分庭设于奎松省Catanauan，为此修订1980年《司法重组法》第14条第(E)款第8项的法案
title.en: An act increasing the number of Regional Trial Court Branches in the Province of Quezon and Lucena City from thirteen (13) branches to fourteen (14) branches by creating a new branch with seat at Catanauan, Quezon, amending for the purpose subparagraph 8 and paragraph (E) of Section 14 of Batas
title.orig: An act increasing the number of Regional Trial Court Branches in the Province of Quezon and Lucena City from thirteen (13) branches to fourteen (14) branches by creating a new branch with seat at Catanauan, Quezon, amending for the purpose subparagraph 8 and paragraph (E) of Section 14 of Batas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2004/ra_9247_2004.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 1 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en: The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court in coordination with the Secretary of the Department of Justice shall immediately include in its program the operationalizaton of the new Regional Trial Court in Catanauan, Quezon, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
